title: DeepSeek pacing and visible effort choices
summary: DeepSeek sends share one paced queue, and the desktop effort menu keeps every choice accessible.
fixed: DeepSeek sends no longer overlap or bypass pacing through Creator and library cards.
Desktop effort choices stay above neighboring settings cards and remain accessible in short windows.
notes: Windows is unsigned and Mac is not notarized. This update is in development.

github.summary: ***Calmer DeepSeek sends and an effort menu that stays visible.***

sections.title: ✨ What's new
items: All PlazCode messages to DeepSeek share one queue.

sections.title: 🛠️ What's fixed
items: Creator and library sends follow the same 8–9.8 second spacing after the previous send finishes. Long replies add no extra wait.
The desktop effort menu stays above other settings cards, with reachable options in short windows.

sections.title: 🧪 What was checked
items: Development checks are in progress; not tested on a live DeepSeek account.
Windows is unsigned and Mac is not notarized, as before.
